summary: TypeScript source code is solid (proper types, error handling, clear logic), but deliverable is incomplete and workflow has critical gaps. Missing: test fixture files (refs line 25-42 `fixtures/...`), test suite, actionlint validation step, act-result.txt generation, output validation (workflow echoes RESULT but never asserts values). BUMP_DATE env var (line 6) set but unused—never passed to script. Repetitive fixture setup (lines 25-42) should factor into reusable helper. No evidence of TDD or workflow structure tests (required). Workflow cannot run without fixtures; act-result.txt requirement unmet.
